title: fight-campaign (schema "fight.campaign/1")
description: data/fight/campaign.json: the campaign's numbers (docs/design/campaign.md; sim/core/campaign.gd; docs/architecture/campaign-core.md). Campaign-only: no versus match and no fighter reads it (Legal mc01, mc06). Its enabled is the campaign's one switch. Policy: closed except keys starting with an underscore.

enabled.description: the campaign's one switch: the host uses none of it while it is off

columns.description: an episode's stages, each a column of the route

from.description: the column whose untaken named place comes back

to.description: the column it is asked again in (before the climax)

crossBack.description: the cross-back (campaign.md 2.2): asked of World as WorldCampaign.column's prefer

sideShare.description: thousandths: the share of main-story episodes won that offer a side story

ringCols.description: the episode's first ring, round the player's home, in columns
